Tesla and SpaceX, both led by Musk, have sued Illinois nanotechnology company
over the “Terafab” name planned for their $16.8 billion AI chip complex in Texas. The lawsuit was filed in response to a cease-and-desist letter from TERA-print.
Goldman Cuts Tesla’s Q3 Delivery Forecast

(NYSE:GS) has revised its Q3 delivery forecast for Tesla, bringing it down to 435,000 vehicles from the previous estimate of 490,000. Despite this, prediction traders are still optimistic, with estimates centered around 480,000. Read the full article here.

(NASDAQ:SPCX) during an appearance on the All In Podcast. Musk was asked why Tesla and SpaceX were still separate companies, to which he hinted that there may be a merger on the way. Read the full article here.
